title: Where I have shipped real things.

items.overview: UI Health manages healthcare and academic operations that depend on faculty, residency, scheduling, and departmental data staying accurate and synchronized across internal systems and public-facing platforms. I build web applications and synchronization workflows that keep that information reliable for patients, staff, and students.
responsibilities: Contributing to a Node.js-based synchronization workflow that pulls faculty, residency, and scheduling data through REST APIs to validate records, detect inconsistencies, and reduce fragmented manual updates across disconnected healthcare systems.
Modernizing legacy scheduling, faculty management, residency, and academic event workflows into React-based applications using specification-driven development.
Improving accessibility, WCAG compliance, reusable component architecture, and cross-browser reliability across clinical and academic workflows.

Improving rendering performance and operational reliability using reusable hooks, state optimization, memoization, debounced search and filter workflows, lazy loading, and recovery handling for inconsistent API responses.
Building Chart.js dashboards and reusable workflow components that help departments monitor scheduling conflicts, residency coverage, and faculty operations.

items.overview: LPS Health is a cardiovascular health and wellness platform focused on preventive care, educational content, community engagement, and donations. The organization needed reliable digital workflows for events, seminars, donations, and engagement, so I led a full-cycle website rebuild within a three-month internship.
responsibilities: Replaced a legacy frontend system with a modern React architecture, redesigning registration, educational, and donation workflows into centralized production-ready user experiences within a three-month timeline.

Improved Lighthouse accessibility score from 40 to 80 and reduced page load time by 70% using lazy loading, image optimization, frontend caching strategies, debounced form handling, state optimization, and accessibility-focused redesign decisions.

Built secure Stripe Checkout workflows with validation, session management, payment recovery handling, and rate-limiting safeguards to improve donation reliability and prevent invalid transaction states.
Managed CI/CD pipelines through GitHub and Netlify to automate build and deployment processes.
Used Google Analytics insights to redesign registration and donation flows, improving workflow completion, engagement, SEO visibility, and frontend usability.

items.overview: Oracle Fusion Cloud builds enterprise applications that support large-scale business operations. I contributed to two Berkshire Hathaway Energy products: BHE-HCM for payroll, scheduling, employee records, and absence management, and BHE-CX Services for field service, work orders, asset maintenance, and inspections.
responsibilities: Built Redwood-style enterprise interfaces in Oracle Visual Builder Studio for BHE-HCM and BHE-CX workflows including payroll approvals, employee scheduling, absence management, work orders, inspections, and asset-maintenance operations using Oracle Fusion REST APIs.
Developed reusable frontend components for HCM and CX modules used across enterprise teams for employee records, scheduling systems, approval workflows, inspection forms, and operational dashboards.
Engineered API integration layers with structured validation, RBAC-aware handling, and secure REST interactions across distributed Oracle Fusion modules.
Collaborated with backend and QA teams during Agile Scrum release cycles to debug cross-module workflow failures.
Resolved 100+ production issues across frontend and API layers, improving reliability and operational stability.
Received an Employee Recognition Award for rapidly mastering Oracle VBS and being selected to support the BHE-HCM product team.
